scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../admin-frontend && npm install
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend" "npm run start --prefix admin-frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,ORDER,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend" "npm run start --prefix admin-frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:order && npm run build:admin
